project.name: cavet
project.description: A Go CLI security-triage tool for coding agents. It runs scanners (trivy, opengrep, gitleaks, checkov) inside an offline container engine and records every finding and decision in an append-only audit log.
project.context: This finding comes from a scan of the cavet repository itself.

finding.description:
engine/Dockerfile:141
Detected docker image with no explicit version attached. Images should be tagged with an explicit version to produce deterministic container images -- attach a version when using `FROM <image>`.
verdict: dismissed (high confidence, by operator): engine/Dockerfile:141 FROM rules references the internal stage defined at line 111 of the same Dockerfile, not a registry image; internal stages cannot carry a version tag

mechanical_context.path_class: container image build definition (shipped as the scanner engine image)
mechanical_context.source_excerpt:
111 | FROM scanners AS rules
  112 | ARG OPENGREP_RULES_SHA
  113 | COPY curate-rules.sh /usr/local/bin/curate-rules.sh
  114 | RUN chmod +x /usr/local/bin/curate-rules.sh \
  115 |     && git init /tmp/rules \
  116 |     && git -C /tmp/rules fetch --depth 1 https://github.com/opengrep/opengrep-rules "$OPENGREP_RULES_SHA" \
  117 |     && git -C /tmp/rules checkout --quiet FETCH_HEAD \
  118 |     && /usr/local/bin/curate-rules.sh /tmp/rules /opt/opengrep-rules \
  119 |     && rm -rf /tmp/rules
  120 | 
  121 | # ---------------------------------------------------------- trivy data ------
  122 | FROM scanners AS trivy-data-core
  123 | # Vulnerability DB baked in; determinism at scan time comes from the offline
